ctx.x: What's the band then, you'd have what, two, two tenets? What do you mean, a saxophone? It was a big band.

It was a big band. It was a big band. Well, there was four or five saxophones. But four saxophones, I'd say, three trumpets and a trombone. Some would have two trumpets, it was a small band, but at that time, like Herbert Liris' band, I used, my uncle August was playing with them and he'd bring me around just to be around the musicians and listen at the band. Even before I was playing music, when I was thirteen, thirteen years old. I remember because they had four saxophones and they had three trumpets and two…
